tells.1: Rhythmic parallel lines ('Every shelf, every table, every book had to earn its place'; 'Maybe it's been reread. Maybe it's been passed along.') and a generic 'Those visits helped us get here' closer.
tells.2: An em dash plus the stock 'One of the lovely things about…:' setup, on top of the same tricolon and 'Maybe… Maybe…' cadence as version 1.
tells.3: No strong stylistic tell. Its risk is credibility: specifics like Middlemarch, Mr. Okafor and the $38,000 GoFundMe appear in no other version and may be invented.
tells.4: Faint: the 'earn its place' line and 'One of the lovely things about ten years in a bookshop' still feel templated, but the cadence is more natural.

reason: Version 3 reads most human because of its concrete details, but those facts appear nowhere else and could be fabricated, so I wouldn't publish it unverified. Version 4 has the cleanest, most natural phrasing without inventing claims.
